title: Dragon Vault
wikitext:
The '''Dragon Vault''' can be found in [[Amberwood Keep]] in [[Northwind]]. Interacting with it while having [[Perfumed Letter (4)|Perfumed Letter #4]] and the [[Violet Key]] allows for the acquisition of [[Lady Selind's Purse]].
